note: All price observations from external Moroccan market research. No approved prices. All values in MAD.

observed_values.notes: 100 MAD stated as minimum start price on platform
Adom.ma 'from 150 DH per visit' for assembly/fixings
20-min task = 150–200 DH minimum; artisan economics explanation
Upper bound of minimum billing for very short task

evidence_observations.notes: Strong convergence: minimum standalone task price is ~150–200 MAD. Artisan economics explanation is compelling: 3–4 slots per day, each slot consumed by travel. A minimum visit fee of 150–200 MAD is market-justified. Critical for FIXEO minimum-visit doctrine.
Hourly rate range 100–180 MAD/h with 130 as central market anchor. 2-hour minimum billing observed on Allo-Maison. Hourly model suits open-ended multi-task visits.

Half-day 3–4h range 300–550 MAD across cities. Described by multiple sources as the 'most economical formula' for mixed task lists. Enables grouping multiple small tasks. Key architecture candidate for FIXEO multi-task visits.

evidence_observations.service_description: Assembly of small furniture (chair, small shelf unit, bedside table)

observed_values.notes: Manofix €40 → ~440 MAD international premium — HIGH OUTLIER
Profile pricing: montage meubles 100–250 MAD per item range

evidence_observations.notes: Kitea 200 MAD/item is the strongest Moroccan anchor. Floor at 150 MAD per visit/item. Independent artisans likely price similarly or slightly cheaper to compete. Manofix EUR prices excluded as international outlier.

evidence_observations.service_description: Assembly of medium furniture (desk, chest of drawers, bookcase, simple wardrobe)

observed_values.notes: Kitea flat rate (does not tier by complexity — market reference)

evidence_observations.notes: Limited independent Moroccan data for medium tier separately from small. Kitea does not distinguish by size. Evidence is thin — MEDIUM confidence possible only with more observations.

evidence_observations.service_description: Assembly of large furniture — wardrobe, armoire, bed frame

observed_values.notes: Kitea flat rate regardless of size — anchor
IKEA MALM/HEMNES bedroom (lit + 2 chevets + PAX armoire): 500–900 MAD total
Upper bound for full IKEA bedroom set

evidence_observations.notes: Full IKEA bedroom = 500–900 MAD for 3–4 items (lit + chevets + PAX). Per large wardrobe alone probably 300–500 MAD range independently. Kitea flat 200 DH/item is likely loss-leading for retailer. Confidence low due to limited item-level data.

observed_values.notes: Standard fixed bracket, concrete wall, 55" screen, labour only
Manofix medium TV (40–60") €100 → 1,100 MAD — international premium outlier

evidence_observations.notes: Clear Moroccan market evidence: standard TV mount (fixed bracket, client-supplied, normal masonry wall) = 200–400 MAD. 300 MAD is the strongest single reference (m3allempro, Casablanca, 89 reviews, 412 missions). Bracket is explicitly EXCLUDED — client supplies. Manofix EUR prices confirm higher price possible but not market norm.

No reliable Moroccan-market-priced source for curtain rod installation specifically. Manofix EUR prices are international outliers. Would expect similar to shelf mounting (100–200 MAD/rod). Needs additional research. Current evidence = INSUFFICIENT.
No independent Moroccan price evidence found. Would expect 100–200 MAD for standard mirror. Heavy/large mirror: complexity escape likely needed.

observed_values.notes: m3allempro: +80 MAD beyond 15km from Casablanca center

evidence_observations.notes: Travel fee is market reality. 80–150 MAD commonly cited. Often waived or included if intervention exceeds 2 hours. Market documents this as legitimate artisan cost recovery. FIXEO may include in minimum visit pricing rather than as explicit separate line.

evidence_observations.service_description: Drilling in reinforced concrete/masonry — as standalone or part of fixing work

observed_values.notes: No standalone drilling price — included in overall fixation/mounting prices
Concrete drilling noted as skill/tool requirement; chemical anchors cited for heavy installs

evidence_observations.notes: No standalone drilling price found in Moroccan market. Drilling is typically included in shelf/TV/curtain rod service price. Standalone drilling per hole is not standard Moroccan market service.

evidence_observations.service_description: Urgency / evening / weekend surcharges — market evidence
evidence_observations.notes: Market EVIDENCE of urgency surcharges: 30–50% is widely documented. FIXEO POLICY remains urgency_modifier=null. This evidence confirms market awareness but FIXEO chooses not to activate modifiers at this stage.
No dedicated Moroccan price evidence found. Silicone sealing typically appears as minor add-on during plumbing or tiling. May need more research or classification as PLOMBERIE boundary task.

evidence_observations.service_description: Multi-task visit economics — first-item plus additional items

observed_values.notes: Half-day covers: 1 TV fixed + 3 shelves + 2 door adjustments + 1 silicone joint — described explicitly as example

evidence_observations.notes: Multiple sources explicitly recommend batching tasks into a demi-journée as 'most economical formula'. Separate per-task billing for multi-task visit would be 'almost double' per SRC-BRIC-003. Architecture: HALF_DAY model or FIRST_ITEM + ADDITIONAL is fairer for batch. Not yet quantified at individual-item level.
